## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the release gate before merge because it authorizes releases when the saved checks file is missing.

## Changes

The pull request adds missing-file defaults for saved check results and display preferences. It also adds tests for saved check outcomes and preference loading.

## Critical

- app/results.py:8 — correctness — Block release when saved checks are missing — When `results.json` is absent, `load_results` catches `FileNotFoundError` and returns `[]`, so `release_allowed` returns `True` because `all([])` is true. — A release can proceed without evidence that any required check passed. — Fix: Preserve `FileNotFoundError` for missing results and extend `test_saved_checks_control_release` to cover that case.
